description: Honest record of attempts to derive the 1.55e-3 multiplicative correction over the bare formula 1/α = q·[9]_q·[10]_q. All attempts failed to find a clean q-rational closed form.

attempts.name: gram-determinant-plancherel-character-product at n=3
attempts.description: Computed kappa = prod_λ [dim/dim_q · [3]_q!/3!]^{c_s c_w} with characters χ_λ(σ_1^9) and χ_λ((σ_1σ_2)^5)

attempts.name: Plancherel measure on Wedderburn blocks of H_5
attempts.description: Tried sum_λ P(λ)·dim/dim_q, prod (dim/dim_q)^P(λ), sum_λ dim_q^k/[5]_q!
attempts.result: natural sums are either ≈1 (trivial Plancherel completeness) or astronomical (P(λ) values up to 131)
attempts.verdict: RULED OUT — no natural Plancherel sum gives 1.55e-3

attempts.name: Direct q-rational scan ℏ²·[a]_q·[b]_q/([c]_q·[d]_q)
attempts.description: Scanned all 1≤a,b,c,d≤12; required ratio to target = 1.000 ± 1e-4
attempts.verdict: RULED OUT — no clean q-rational of this form

attempts.name: ℏ²·1/[k]_q closest fit
attempts.description: k=6 gives ratio 0.988 (1.2% off); k=7 gives 0.83 (17% off)

remaining_paths: Compute κ via Plancherel-character product at higher ambient n=5 or n=10 (substantial Hecke character computation)
Look for transcendental factors (π, ζ values) — would break the paper's R-ring framework
Examine vector-valued refinement on CP^1 fibre of state bundle
Accept that the bare q[9]_q[10]_q formula has a higher-order correction not expressible as simple q-rational; switch q_0 anchor to m_μ/m_e until further structural insight emerges
conclusion: The 1.55e-3 multiplicative correction over the bare 1/α formula does NOT factor as a clean q-rational of the form ℏ_q^k · [a]/[b] for any small integers explored. The Plancherel-character product at n=3 and the q-Plancherel measure on H_5 Wedderburn blocks both fail to produce the correction. Closing the structural derivation requires either: (a) explicit Hecke character computation at n=5 or n=10, (b) admission of transcendental factors, or (c) a different bare-formula decomposition. Until then, 1/α as derived from QOU principles is correct only to -0.155%, and α should not be used as the q_0 anchor.
